$comment: #805 organic flags on fertilizer plugins, same rule as the complianceFlags section of epa-reg-sources.json (#779): a plugin may set omriListed, certifiedOrganicAllowed or transitioningAllowed to true only with an entry here, either an OMRI Products List NOP listing ({ omriListed: true, sourceUrl on omri.org, quote "<product> | <company> | <OMRI code> | NOP | <status> | expires <date>" }) or, for a generic plugin that names no brand, a 7 CFR 205 quote that names the material ({ basis: "7 CFR 205", citation, sourceUrl on ecfr.gov, quote }), which never sets omriListed. omriListed: false entries record why a plugin carries no allowed flag. Rulings F805-1 to F805-4 in docs/design/LABEL_FOLLOWUP_RULINGS.md. eCFR text up to date as of 2026-10-07. Checked by fertilizerOrganicSources.gate.test.ts.
